evidence.title: GitHub - THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom

name: OpenMAIC
summary: Open-source classroom platform that turns one prompt into a multi-agent course, with an agent workbench to plan and revise lessons.
description: Self-hostable web app that generates a complete interactive course from a single prompt, taught by multiple AI agents. v1.0.0 adds a chat-first agent workbench that plans, builds and revises whole courses from uploaded materials, with durable sessions that survive restarts. Supports Amazon Bedrock and local providers such as Lemonade, local speech recognition with FunASR, and deploys locally, on Vercel or with Docker.
contains: one prompt generates a full interactive course
agent workbench plans, builds and revises whole courses in chat
durable sessions: cancel, resume and steer a run
upload documents and audio as session materials
providers: Amazon Bedrock, Lemonade local AI, FunASR local speech
deploy locally, on Vercel or with Docker; MIT license
